principles.name: Platform before feature
principles.statement: Build capabilities that strengthen the whole platform.

principles.name: Explainable decisions
principles.statement: Automated decisions must expose reasons, evidence and version metadata.

principles.name: Release confidence
principles.statement: Every release is complete, replaceable, testable and rollback-aware.

principles.name: Non-technical operation
principles.statement: The owner should operate and maintain the platform through clear guidance rather than code.

principles.name: Stable guest experience
principles.statement: Infrastructure changes must not destabilise the public hospitality experience.
